brief:
Turkey's Humanitarian Relief Foundation announced plans to dispatch a new maritime fleet to Gaza, with large vessels set to sail from various ports worldwide during April and May 2027, according to Shehab Wire. Foundation head Bülent Yıldırım said the ships would participate in an international maritime operation aimed at delivering aid to the territory.

The convoy represents a fresh international effort to support Gaza amid the ongoing humanitarian situation in the enclave.

title: Turkish relief agency prepares ships for Gaza aid convoy
